name: load-house-rules
description: Loads Gmor45's standing operating rules from the private claude-audit repo at session start, enforces the plain-English closing block on every reply, carries /wherewasi — a plain-English board of every Claude Code chat currently running — and reminds Claude, once per session, when a prompt looks mechanical enough to hand to the bundled haiku-mechanic subagent instead of the main model. Pointers, not copies, so nothing here drifts out of date.
